known_issues.title: Intel 13th/14th Gen Raptor Lake CPU Vmin Shift Degradation
symptoms: Frequent WHEA_UNCORRECTABLE_ERROR (0x124) BSODs under moderate load
System instability that worsens over time
Random reboots during gaming or compilation
known_issues.root_cause: Intel acknowledged elevated voltage requests causing permanent silicon degradation. The CPU requires progressively higher voltage to maintain stability.
remediation: Update to latest BIOS with Intel Default Settings microcode (0x125+)
Apply Intel Baseline Profile (disables eTVB, limits PL2)
Set manual Vcore offset +0.02-0.05V as temporary workaround
Contact Intel for RMA/replacement under extended warranty program

known_issues.title: VMware Workstation and Hyper-V Coexistence Causing System Freezes
symptoms: Complete system freeze (no BSOD, requires hard reset)
Black screen with cursor after resume from sleep
High DPC latency spikes when VM is running
known_issues.root_cause: VMware WHP mode (required when Hyper-V is active) introduces additional virtualization overhead that can conflict with certain GPU drivers and cause DPC watchdog violations.
remediation: Disable VMware services when not in use
Update GPU drivers to latest stable version
Disable Device Guard / Credential Guard if not required
